title: Fixed Corner Squinches and Open Octagonal Drum
description: One complete newly authored static square-to-octagonal architectural transition module. Unlike the old continuous spherical sail-vault shell, there is no central round roof flowing into spherical corner sails; unlike a freestanding full voussoir gateway, each new corner vault spans diagonally inside two perpendicular supports. All geometry and coordinates new, no old arch or pier meshes imported. Three opaque PBR roles, metre Z-up, full horizontal-bounds-centred four corner soles, one architectural module zero scenes.
